items.title: I drove Tesla for the first time; I felt happy like a child for the first 10 minutes, and was totally disappointed the r
items.summary:
I drove Tesla for the first time; I felt happy like a child for the first 10 minutes, and was totally disappointed the rest of the ride

The autopilot feature is not available in the EU, but even the lane-control works extremely badly

Tesla didn't recognize road works and almost crushed me into a barrier

Then it went completely crazy on a temporary orange lane and started wiggling around

The assistant consistently missed lanes and ignored speed limit signs, so I had to disable the assistant and drive manually

I drove an electric BMW i4 before, and it had a much better cruise control and assistant (it boggles my mind that BMW kicked Tesla's ass in software)

With BMW, I never had to touch the gas pedal and drove the car just using cruise control and speed limit assistant

You could also set a speed limit, and even if you pressed full gas, it never crossed, which was handy in a city

Tesla is still an insane product, the interior and exterior design are amazing, but it feels like an app with an amazing frontend and a very poor backend (at least in the EU)

Driving gave me a lot of motivation to make more $$$, and I will still probably get a Tesla, and not a BMW bz BMW is a car for boomers

items.title: Emerging Risks to Watch: AI, Data Centers, and Autonomous Vehicles - Insurance Journal
items.summary: # Emerging Risks to Watch: AI, Data Centers, and Autonomous Vehicles. We examine how the expanding use of AI is reshaping the risk landscape for insurance–not only within the industry but across the broader economy and physical world. From cybersecurity and data privacy concerns to the infrastructure required to support AI, to its growing role in autonomous systems, understanding where AI-related risks may emerge is essential to managing them effectively. The wide-ranging–and growing–list of AI capabilities and applications makes it difficult to determine how the transformative technology may impact potential losses across specific insurance lines of business. A recently reported security incident involving data access from a popular enterprise generative AI tool highlights how the mass adoption of large language models (LLMs) and the concentration of the office software market may increase the potential for systemic liability exposure across cyber and professional and management liability lines.

items.title: AI Marketing Features - Trend Hunter
items.summary: Adweek published a report on agentic AI tools in marketing, featuring insights from the ADWEEK House Possible Group Chat co-hosted with Mutinex and participants from Hershey, Breeze Airways and PubMatic. The discussion focused on agentic AI systems designed to automate workflows, support measurement and connect large datasets with creative and strategic marketing tasks while maintaining human oversight. Speakers shared examples ranging from media-mix modelling that reduced data preparation time from months to hours to AI-assisted campaign workflows that remove repetitive tasks and allow teams to focus on higher-level planning and creativity. For marketers, agentic AI is increasingly positioned as a productivity layer that frees teams to spend more time on strategy, taste and creative judgment rather than manual execution. 3. **AI-assisted Creative Collaboration** — Tools that blend generative models with human oversight to iterate on strategy, tone and creative assets present opportunities to reshape agency-client workflows and redefine creative production timelines.

items.title: Agentic AI: Navigating The Evolving Frontier - Forbes
items.summary: # Agentic AI: Navigating The Evolving Frontier. As 2026 advances, the digital landscape has evolved to be increasingly proactive and “always-on.” Using technology to guide decisions is leading to the delegation of authority. AI systems that function with machine agency are referred to as "agentic AI." These systems can read intent, plan multi-step activities, use tools, access systems, and carry out tasks independently with little assistance from humans. The age of Agentic AI is transformative rather than incremental. Agentic AI is distinct from passive automation. This moment is characterized by operational autonomy and technical innovation. Agentic AI is increasingly establishing itself as the standard decision-making framework in critical systems. The implication is profound: algorithmic velocity is evolving into a form of national power. Agentic AI expedites the move to autonomous risk. Organizations must transition from reactive cybersecurity to "Security by Design" to mitigate these assaults. In terms of national security, AI autonomy will provide countries with considerable benefits in defense, intelligence, and cybersecurity.

items.title: GenAI: Moving to the forefront of claims management - InsuranceNewsNet
items.summary: # GenAI: Moving to the forefront of claims management - Insurance News | InsuranceNewsNet. HomeNow reading Property and Casualty News. Property and Casualty News RSSGet our newsletter. Claims teams use AI-assisted tools to sort incoming materials, summarize large files and support litigation strategy, while defense counsel uses GenAI to draft outlines, organize chronologies and prepare initial drafts. But for risk managers overseeing claims operations, the question is no longer whether AI should be used, but how to deploy it without introducing new operational, legal or reputational risks. Let’s explore how AI is being used across claims handling and defense, where it delivers tangible value, where it still falls short, and what recent cases and regulatory developments mean for companies managing risk. When it comes to handling and defending claims, AI is already proving most useful in three core areas: document review, case summarization and litigation support.

For the modern business, AI is more than just a means to an end. Aside from the front-end benefits focused on efficiency, AI is adopting a vital role in every boardroom: strategy. Simply put, AI is more than a tool in fintech. It is rapidly becoming the solution to every company’s growth strategy. In this Q&A with FinTech Magazine, Benjamin Funk, Chief Technology & AI Officer at Acrisure, explains how Acrisure’s AI strategy is the core of its operation. At Acrisure, I’m now leading technology, innovation, and AI across our engineering, data, analytics, product, sales tech and agentic automation teams. Not as an overlay, but as a critical and core engine for how a business ought to run.

items.title: Florida sues OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman, accusing them of putting profit over safety - NBC News
items.summary: # Florida sues OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman, accusing them of putting profit over safety. Florida seeks to hold Sam Altman personally liable, accusing OpenAI of marketing ChatGPT as safe while concealing that it could drive users toward harm. Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier sued OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman on Monday, accusing the company of putting profit over safety, fueling violence and pushing a product it knew could harm users. “The rise of OpenAI is attributable to a web of deceit and the exploitation of users (including Floridians), leveraging their data and safety to boost OpenAI’s market value at unacceptable costs,” the complaint reviewed by NBC News and filed Monday said. Florida is the first state to sue OpenAI and Altman over design and safety. “Last year’s mass shooting at Florida State University was a tragedy, but ChatGPT is not responsible for this terrible crime,” OpenAI spokesman Drew Pusateri said in a statement to NBC News after the company was sued by the family of a victim of the shooting.

items.title: Florida sues OpenAI, Sam Altman, in first-of-its-kind lawsuit over violent incidents - TechCrunch
items.summary: # Florida sues OpenAI, Sam Altman, in first-of-its-kind lawsuit over violent incidents. OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, were sued by the Florida Attorney General on Monday, in a first-of-its-kind state litigation effort over ChatGPT’s alleged links to a number of violent incidents. The lawsuit accuses OpenAI of looking the other way on safety concerns as it has sought to prioritize winning “the AI arms race and amass large fortunes.”. “Today, we announced the first-in-the-nation state-led lawsuit against OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman,” said Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier. That probe sought to determine what role ChatGPT may have played in a mass shooting that took place last year at Florida State University. OpenAI has also been sued in a civil suit by the family of one of the victims of that shooting.

items.title: OpenAI Launches Rosalind Biodefense, Offers Free AI Model to Governments for Pandemic Preparedness - MLQ.ai
items.summary: # OpenAI Launches Rosalind Biodefense, Offers Free AI Model to Governments for Pandemic Preparedness. * OpenAI launched Rosalind Biodefense, a two-track program giving vetted developers and U.S. government agencies free access to GPT-Rosalind for pandemic preparedness and biosecurity work [1]. * GPT-Rosalind outperforms GPT-5, GPT-5.2, and GPT-5.4 on internal benchmarks in chemistry, biochemistry, and experiment design [2]. OpenAI on May 29 launched Rosalind Biodefense, a program that provides free access to its specialized life sciences AI model, GPT-Rosalind, for government agencies, academic institutions, and nonprofit developers working on pandemic preparedness and biodefense [1]. The program operates on two tracks: a developer track sponsoring vetted teams building epidemiological models, early-detection tools, and screening systems, and a government track extending access to select U.S. federal agencies and allied partners for outbreak-response planning, diagnostics, and medical countermeasure development [3]. The Rosalind Biodefense program expands GPT-Rosalind's use from general life-science research into national security and public health applications, marking the first time OpenAI has offered a specialized model free of charge to government partners at this scale [3].

result.actual_text:
Để gửi email tự động bằng PHP, bạn có thể sử dụng hàm `mail()` có sẵn trong PHP. Dưới đây là một số ý tưởng cho việc gửi email tự động:

1. **Thông báo đơn hàng**: Gửi email xác nhận cho khách hàng khi họ đặt hàng thành công trên trang web của bạn.

2. **Nhắc nhở sự kiện**: Gửi email nhắc nhở cho người dùng về các sự kiện sắp diễn ra, chẳng hạn như hội thảo, buổi họp, hoặc sinh nhật.

3. **Báo cáo hàng tuần**: Tự động gửi báo cáo hàng tuần cho quản lý hoặc nhóm về hiệu suất công việc hoặc doanh thu.

4. **Chào mừng người dùng mới**: Gửi email chào mừng cho người dùng mới khi họ đăng ký tài khoản trên trang web của bạn.

5. **Khôi phục mật khẩu**: Gửi email hướng dẫn khôi phục mật khẩu cho người dùng khi họ yêu cầu.

6. **Thông báo tin tức**: Gửi email thông báo về các tin tức mới nhất hoặc cập nhật từ công ty hoặc trang web của bạn.

Bạn có thể kết hợp các ý tưởng này với các thư viện như PHPMailer hoặc SwiftMailer để có thêm tính năng và bảo mật.
